verdict.rationale: Mastra is an Apache 2.0 framework you can self-host and deploy to any Node.js-compatible environment, including Bun, Deno, or Cloudflare, so you control where your data lives by choosing where to run it. There is no documented region or residency selection for Mastra's hosted offerings, and the evidence doesn't detail which storage backends you can configure. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for hosted Studio/cloud, documented configurable storage backend locations, any data-residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration.
